Who we are

About AS Dental Lab

AS Dental Lab is a digital dental laboratory in Baramati, Pune, built to support dentists and dental clinics with precision-crafted laboratory solutions. We are a laboratory, not a clinic: we work with dentists, never in place of them.

Our focus is a clear digital workflow, aesthetic restorations, crowns, implant prosthetics and aligners, finished with careful laboratory craftsmanship and service designed around the dentist's needs.
